summary: Wrote pnr/floorplan.json (core_utilization_pct=45 with reasons for utilization, pins, power grid and clock/reset) and pnr/pin_order.cfg (W: wr_en, wr_data.*, rd_en; E: rd_data.*; N: full, almost_full, empty, overflow, underflow, count.*; S: clk, rst_n). No tool was run by me; floorplan, PDN and pin-order parsing checks are pending the runtime.
assumptions: Cell area 26,049.984 um2 from reports/synth_tool.json is the basis for utilization.
Default SKY130 PDN parameters are used unchanged since pnr_ranges.yaml has no strap ranges.

OpenLane matches pin patterns from the start of the name (re.match), so 'full' does not also match 'almost_full', 'wr_en' does not match 'wr_data', and 'rd_en' does not match 'rd_data'. If the parser uses unanchored search, 'full' would also match almost_full and must be revisited.
rd_en is grouped with the other inputs on West to keep all inputs on one side, per the task instruction.
open_issues: Pre-layout setup slack at ss_100C_1v60 is only 0.306 ns on rd_data paths, driven by a fanout-128 rd_addr select flop (3.65 ns Q delay); placement/CTS buffering must fix this net or the worst-corner slack may go negative after layout. Flagged for the PnR/timing agent.
Utilization 45% is the default; final core area is to be reported for G1 review (REQ-020).

self_assessment.reason: Utilization and pin grouping follow the inputs directly; the main uncertainty is the exact pattern-matching semantics of the OpenLane pin-order parser for 'full' vs 'almost_full', which the runtime check will confirm.
